findings.title: Enforce and charge the entire prelaunch phase
findings.detail: The300s timer starts after authorization-manifest hashing. validate_package is called without its check callback and environment_admission also runs before any resource guard; a slow hash/git/filesystem/environment operation can exceed the phase ceiling before rejection. Later, runtime_check.wall_seconds is frozen at line167, before writing/hashing the runtime receipts and launch claim, the final guard, and spawn/launch overhead. The detached science parent sees only that earlier number, leaving a gap in cumulative accounting. The final guard can prevent a late start but cannot retroactively enforce or charge the complete prelaunch interval.
findings.required_change: Use one absolute prelaunch deadline and resource guard from the start of authorized byte work, including package/environment admission and bounded subprocesses. Bind a conservative, explicitly labelled handoff allowance or another enforceable end-to-end accounting mechanism so all remaining prelaunch/spawn work is charged without borrowing numerical time. Keep the default/false-approval gate before preflight/spawn and preserve one-shot failure semantics. Add artificial clock/blocking-operation tests.

findings.title: Enforce one declared new-archive budget across control and scientific output
findings.detail: guard checks only CONTROL against1GiB while the unchanged scientific supervisor checks only OUTPUT against1GiB. The extracted source alone is47,994,968bytes in CONTROL, before receipt/log growth, so an otherwise permitted near1GiB OUTPUT would exceed the frozen single new_archive_bytes=1GiB budget. The launcher two-GiB free-space check does not enforce the stated one-GiB archive cap; the prepared package/source tar adds further storage if it is included in that policy.
findings.required_change: Keep the frozen scientific code unchanged and enforce the declared combined archive scope while detached work runs, stopping only task-owned work if total controlled new bytes exceed1GiB. Explicitly identify whether immutable prepared package bytes count, and reserve/account for control/source/log bytes; do not silently turn the single cap into two independent caps. Add a synthetic combined-storage boundary check.
